services.desc: Lilleys’ Landing marina in Branson, Missouri has everything you need to enjoy Lake Taneycomo! Bass boat, pontoon boat, and Jon boat rentals are available from 2-hour periods up to multi-day excursions. Our marina also offers boat stalls for rent (guests only) and fish cleaning stations. services.name: 25' Pontoon
services.desc: See the beauty of Lake Taneycomo from the water! Our pontoon rentals are equipped with everything you need including live wells, swivel fishing seats, a bench seat, and buggy top. Our pontoons are powered by 90HP Yamaha motors - providing plenty of power to navigate Lake Taneycomo regardless of the current. They are great for groups and are rigged for fishing or cruising. The Branson Landing is only a short four mile run downstream from our marina for a lakeside view of the fountains. We have nine pontoon boats in our fleet, so we can handle the largest of groups!
